result.topic_en: Bare calculations: Laplace's equation in spherical coordinates, a series solution in the variable z with coefficients given by Gauss Pi-function ratios and integral representations, followed by a saddle-point (Laplace method) asymptotic evaluation involving log x = psi(0) - pi cot phi.
result.transcription:
$\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2}+\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial r^2}-\frac{1}{r}\frac{\partial u}{\partial r}+\frac{1}{r r}\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial \psi^2}=0$
$\left(\left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial r}\right)^2+\left(\frac{\partial u}{r\partial\varphi}\right)^2+\left(\frac{\partial u}{r\sin\varphi\,\partial\psi}\right)^2\right)\sin\varphi\,\partial\psi\,\partial\varphi\,r^2\partial r$
